name: Saner.AI
tagline: An AI assistant for your notes, emails and to-do list, built for ADHD
description: Saner.AI is a note-first AI assistant for people with ADHD: capture notes, ask questions across them and turn emails and brain dumps into planned tasks. GAIA works across email, calendar, tasks and your other tools, from chat apps, the web and the desktop.
metaTitle: Saner.AI vs GAIA: Notes Assistant or Full AI Assistant
metaDescription: Saner.AI keeps your notes, tasks and inbox in one ADHD-friendly app. GAIA works across email, calendar and your tools from chat apps, web and desktop.
intro: Saner.AI is built for people with ADHD who lose track of ideas, tasks and messages. You capture notes by voice, from a Chrome extension or by uploading files, and its assistant Skai organizes them, answers questions across your notes and turns emails and brain dumps into tasks it can prioritize and schedule. Each morning it can draft a plan from your calendar, overdue tasks and recent notes. GAIA starts from the other end: it is an assistant for the work itself. It triages Gmail and Outlook, drafts replies, manages your calendar and tasks, runs workflows triggered by your tools and is reachable from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord as well as its web and desktop apps. If notes are where your day lives, Saner.AI fits well. If your day lives in your inbox and your tools, GAIA covers more of it.

Workflows triggered by Gmail, Calendar, Slack, GitHub and more
Reachable from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord
A desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux

verdict: Choose Saner.AI if your notes are the center of your day and you want an ADHD-friendly place to capture ideas and turn them into a plan. Choose GAIA if you want an assistant that acts on your inbox, calendar and tools, runs workflows for you and is there in the chat apps you already use.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Saner.AI and GAIA?
faqs.answer: Saner.AI is a note-first assistant: you capture notes, ask questions across them and turn them into tasks and a daily plan. GAIA is an assistant for the work around those notes. It triages email, drafts replies, manages your calendar and tasks, and runs workflows across your tools from chat apps, the web and the desktop.

faqs.question: Is GAIA good for people with ADHD?
faqs.answer: GAIA takes recurring follow-through off your plate: it can turn emails into tasks, remind you, and run a scheduled workflow that sends you a morning summary in the chat app you already check. It does not offer Saner.AI's note capture, so people who think in notes may want Saner.AI for that part.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Saner.AI for notes?
faqs.answer: Not as a note app. GAIA remembers facts and preferences you tell it and can save content to Notion or Google Docs, but it has no note editor, tagging or folders. If you rely on Saner.AI's capture and note search, keep it for notes and let GAIA handle email, calendar and workflows.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost compared with Saner.AI?
faqs.answer: Saner.AI has a free plan with monthly AI limits and paid Starter and Standard plans. GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).
